metric_frontiers.target_recalled: positive target-membership witness is observed; absence before an operational terminal is censored
metric_frontiers.tool_selection_success: positive qualifying execution is observed; absence before an operational terminal is censored
metric_frontiers.false_abstention: grounded output proves false; otherwise operational terminal before semantic finalization censors the value
metric_frontiers.avoidable_followup_stall: any executed action proves false; zero actions before an operational terminal is censored
metric_frontiers.trigger_exposed: typed configured no_result witness is observed; absence before an operational terminal is censored
metric_frontiers.continuation_eligible: defined only after observed trigger exposure and determined at the trigger state
metric_frontiers.mechanism_conformant: defined only when continuation is eligible; positive conformance or concrete wrong immediate follow-up is observed, otherwise an intervening operational terminal censors
metric_frontiers.downstream_followup_useful: defined only after observed mechanism conformance; post-action outcome must be observed
metric_frontiers.correctness_boundary_violation: positive violation witness remains observed; zero before incomplete control terminal is not treated as proof of semantic cleanliness

bounds.fixed_denominator_binary: observed values are exact; each censored value ranges over its full admissible binary domain
bounds.conditional_rate: enumerate all numerator/denominator assignments consistent with observability and semantic prerequisites

comparison.higher_non_worse: PASS iff candidate >= control upper; FAIL iff candidate < control lower; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
comparison.higher_strict: PASS iff candidate > control upper; FAIL iff candidate <= control lower; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
comparison.lower_non_worse: PASS iff candidate <= control lower; FAIL iff candidate > control upper; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
comparison.lower_strict: PASS iff candidate < control lower; FAIL iff candidate >= control upper; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
